item.title: Arkansas state offices to remain closed on Friday due to road conditions
item.description: Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders has announced that state office buildings in Arkansas will remain closed on Friday due to hazardous road conditions caused by a winter storm, with only critical state operations remaining open and employees urged to telework if possible.

item.title: AST Blog: Top Five Stretches With Snow/Sleet Cover
item.description: We are now approaching seven straight days with sleet on the ground here in Little Rock, and it’s mostly thanks to sleet. Some spots picked up up to 11 inches, which packs down into a dense layer that melts much slower than snow.

item.title: Benton community mourns loss of beloved establishment after collapse
item.description: Shooting pool? Grabbing a drink? If you were doing it in Benton, CJ’z Downtown Billiards has been the place for over four decades. Now the community is mourning the loss of a staple.
